changes: Added Staff On-Duty/Off-Duty Timetable Excel reports: employee numbers, names and daily clock pairs are read from the contents, independent of the filename.
Keeps employees without taps, repeated clocks and employee blocks split across printed pages.
Unreadable clocks are kept as notes with a warning. Valid neighboring times are imported; missing digits are never guessed.
The blue interface, Standard/Pro features, saved work and printed CSC Form 48 remain unchanged.
